strings.DashboardDescription: A live summary of your computer and its resources.
strings.GraphicsUsageUnavailable: GPU load sensor data is unavailable
strings.GraphicsUsageDetails: Load is read from a hardware sensor exposed by the graphics adapter.
strings.TemperatureAvailabilityNote: Some temperature sensors may require administrator access. The app will not elevate or install a driver.
strings.SensorsUnavailableDescription: Sensor availability depends on hardware and access support. Missing values are never estimated.
strings.NoActivity: There is no activity in this session yet.
strings.ActivityDescription: Completed tasks will appear here when activity history is implemented.
strings.ModulePreparing: This module has not been implemented yet.

strings.ModuleNextStep: Features will be added with a safety preview and clear user confirmation.
strings.UnhandledError: An unexpected error occurred. Details were saved to the local log file.
strings.LanguageFolderDescription: Add or remove languages using JSON files.
strings.HardwareDescription: Hardware information reported by Windows. This page only reads system data.
strings.DiskWmiNote: This WMI status is not a SMART health test. Disk health is not measured here.
strings.HardwareSensorsNote: GPU load and temperature come from supported hardware sensors. Fan readings are not shown yet.

strings.HardwareDataReadError: Some hardware information could not be read.
strings.MemoryMaxSpeedNote: The firmware-reported SMBIOS maximum is shown in MT/s. Configured memory clock is shown separately; firmware data may be incomplete.
strings.ThemeDescription: Choose the app's color appearance. Your choice is saved on this computer.

strings.ThemeWhiteDescription: A light appearance for bright environments.
strings.ReportCreated: The report was saved and opened.

strings.ReportNoHardwareData: No data was available for this section.
